title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E11 — The Doctor Is Out
The team journeys to a South American jungle to rescue Murdock's kidnapped therapist (Richard Anderson); guest Jeannetta Arnette.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E12 — Uncle Buckle-Up
The mob forces a children's TV-show host (Arte Johnson) to endorse cheap, unsafe Uncle Buckle-Up dolls.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E13 — Wheel of Fortune
Agents detour Murdock to South America when he embarks on a Hawaiian trip he won on "Wheel of Fortune"; guests Pat Sajak, Vanna White.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E14 — The A-Team Is Coming, The A-Team Is Coming
The team works with the Soviets to prevent an insane Soviet general from triggering World War III; guest William Smith.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E20 — Kindred Spirits
Banner joins an archaeological dig to learn about a prehistoric Hulk; guests Kim Cattrall, A Martinez.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E18 — The Disciple
Banner's friend Li Sung (Mako) hands over the leadership of his group to a police officer; guests Rick Springfield, Gerald McRaney.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E17 — Mystery Man
Banner becomes the Hulk to save himself and McGee from a forest fire.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E21 — The Confession
Plagued by a young assistant, McGee finds a lonely young man who claims to be the Hulk; guest Markie Post.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E4 — The Slam
Arrested for vagrancy, Banner's fellow work-camp inmates accuse him of being an informer; guest Charles Napier.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E1 — A Knight in Shining Armor
A simple package delivery becomes more complicated than it seems when Mike and KITT learn the package is actually a man with top-secret code decryption built into his DNA.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S2 E14 — Diamonds Aren't a Girl's Best Friend
A model who unwittingly became a jewel smuggler's (Cameron Mitchell) pawn is killed; guest Jo Ann Pflug.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E11 — Musical Mania
Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E12 — Helpful
An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E14 — School Days
The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E15 — The Professor
Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E16 — Syndrome
Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).
